the intended paper-method direction under
`SCI-FRUIT-OD-RESIDUAL-RELEARNING-DIRECTION-2026-09-08`.
The complete method combination and exact upstream amendments remain pending.

The algorithm direction, contract admission, effective configuration and a
particular execution are separate states. The processing chain is currently
not admitted under the bound PTC/MAP parents; that is not a claim that PCA is
undefined or must use precomputed eigenvectors. There is no new scope-review
cycle or request to choose the learning schedule again.
